definitions.explanation: The softer red glow that follows {夕焼|ゆうや}け in the western sky after the sun has set. Used mainly in the fixed pair {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ rather than on its own.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The sunset and afterglow are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {童謡|どうよう}の「{夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ」をみんなで{歌|うた}った。
examples.english: We all sang the children's song "Yūyake Koyake" together.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけの{空|そら}を{見上|みあ}げながら、{子供|こども}たちは{家|いえ}へと{帰|かえ}っていった。
examples.english: Looking up at the glowing evening sky, the children headed home.

notes:
Almost never used alone — it appears as the second half of {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ, where it functions partly as a sound-pattern echo of {夕焼|ゆうや}け. Famous from the children's song "{夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ," which plays from public-address systems in many Japanese neighborhoods at 5 p.m. to signal that children should head home.

FORMS:
- {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ: sunset (with afterglow) — the standard pair
- {夕焼|ゆうや}け: sunset glow — the bright red glow at sunset itself
- {朝焼|あさや}け: morning glow — the dawn equivalent
